fact: The Fichier unique de référence, in operation for about twenty years, is the application the public service ministry currently uses to manage state human resources and feeds the Solde payroll, though it has coding malfunctions that leave regularised situations invisible to payroll (L'Union, 27 August 2026; meeting of 25 August 2026).

Gabon officially launched its Integrated Public Financial Management System (SIGFIP) on 15 January 2026, connected to the public treasury and covering spending execution (operating, investment, debt) and procurement, to be rolled out nationally (Ecofin Agency).
SIGFIP, launched 15 January 2026, centralises the state's tax, customs and non-tax revenue collection and payments in a single database with a single payment interface (Ecofin Agency).
SIGFIP went live on 15 January 2026, moving Gabon from fragmented systems to one integrated platform (Ecofin Agency).

The finance minister launched SIGFIP officially on 15 January 2026, with the expenditure chain integrated from commitment to payment, electronic signature operational, deployment across the national territory and diplomatic missions, and a payment-order registration witnessed at the Justice ministry (Infos Gabon).

SIGFIP centralises the collections of the régies financières with consolidated dashboards for real-time tracking of state revenue; the Budget, Tax, Treasury and Public Procurement directors-general attended the check on 15 January 2026 (Infos Gabon).
A ministerial meeting on 13 January 2026 reported the launch of the Integrated Public Finance Management System (SIGFIP) to streamline government financial operations.

A seminar at Oyem from 4 to 11 March 2026 trained credit officers from the five departments of Woleu-Ntem on the expenditure module of the State's new digital public-finance management application, whose rollout began in 2026 with expenditure.

The Presidency states SIGFIP was officially launched on 15 January 2026, centralises state financial flows, integrates the financial agencies on one platform and covers the budget chain from programming to payment.
SIGFIP, supplied under a convention signed on 31 May 2024 with IKA Technology, was officially launched on 15 January 2026; the document does not say which system it replaced.
